correctness.rationale: The dimension-five spherical harmonic addition theorem yields the normalized Gegenbauer kernel P_l(inner product). Even-degree antipodal symmetry makes the 15×15 Gram matrix I+uA+vB for triangular graph J(6,2), with adjacency spectra (8,6),(2,−3),(−2,1) on dimensions 1,5,9. Odd degrees use a signed complete-graph incidence matrix D with D*D eigenvalues 6 (multiplicity five) and 0 (multiplicity ten), yielding 1+4u and 1−2u. Exact rational Legendre recurrence independently re-evaluated l=0..63; minimum for l>=3 was 21/64 in degree four. For l>=64, Legendre derivative identity and |P_m(x)|<=1 yield |u|<=4/(l+2), |v|<=2/(l+2), so all spectral branches >=1−44/(l+2)>=1/3>21/64. Thus finite cutoff plus analytic tail proves all integer degrees, not extrapolation.
